title: Design tokens v2 and shared Vati Workspace component kit
scope: Replace the shared tokens with the v2 contract and build the shared components once (header, app rail and sidebar, page header, notices, table toolbar, data table, usage line, key-facts strip, routed tabs, drawer, dialog, status chip, empty state, skeleton, toast, command palette) on frappe-ui, used by both apps

acceptance.text: apps/shared/design tokens implement the v2 colour, type, spacing, radius and status values with measured WCAG AA contrast for every text/background pair used
Each shared component exists once, is used by both apps where relevant and appears in the rebuilt showcase in normal, hover, focus, disabled, loading, empty and error states
No Cloudflare or Zoho logo, colour, illustration or copy is used; patterns only (ADR-044); the stack stays Vue 3 + frappe-ui

Screenshots at 1440, 1024 and 390px with loading, empty, error and denied states, keyboard/focus and axe results, and the TAX-144 page-length result; record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Component tests, showcase screenshots and axe

notes.text: Added 2026-11-08 from ADR-044 (one Vati Workspace identity and design system v2) after the user's UI review against Cloudflare's dashboard and Zoho Workplace.
